description: This file defines a Preprocessor class for text preprocessing, including tokenization, lemmatization, and cleaning functions, and integrates with a bug localization component.

classes.name: Preprocessor
classes.description: A class providing methods for text preprocessing, including tokenization, lemmatization, and cleaning, with integration to bug localization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Preprocessor with a BugLocalization instance.

methods.name: camel_case_split
methods.description: Splits camelCase identifiers into separate tokens using regex.

methods.name: tokenize_text
methods.description: Tokenizes input text into words, splitting camelCase words.

methods.name: remove_special_characters
methods.description: Removes special characters and punctuation from input text.

methods.name: get_pos_tag
methods.description: Returns the WordNet POS tag for a given token.

methods.name: lemmatize_tokens
methods.description: Lemmatizes a list of tokens based on their POS tags.

methods.name: preprocess_text
methods.description: Performs comprehensive text preprocessing including cleaning, tokenization, stop word removal, lemmatization, and embedding calculation.
